reader.packets_decoded: sonar (0), notes (1); navigation, attitude and serial packets are not used
reader.speed_units: SensorSpeed read as knots (XTF specification) and converted to m/s
reader.sample_order: sample 0 is the earliest (nearest) sample on both channels

processing.pixel_convention: continuous pixel x spans column c as [c, c+1); ground offset from nadir = (x - nadir_col) * m_per_px_across, positive to starboard. Row k's navigation describes continuous y = k + 0.5.

bottom_track.method: first sample above quiet + BT_THRESHOLD_FRAC * (bright - quiet) that keeps BT_PERSIST_FRAC of the next BT_PERSIST_M above half that margin, per side, refined to the half-height crossing; sides combined (header, else the later return, decides a disagreement); detections further than BT_OUTLIER_M from a median filter along track replaced by the filtered value; header altitude where the tracker found nothing, or disagreed with a plausible header by more than BT_HEADER_TOLERANCE_FRAC

slant_range_correction.formula: ground = sqrt(slant^2 - altitude^2), resampled linearly onto ground-range bin centres (j + 0.5) * m_per_px_across
slant_range_correction.basis: auto: median slant-range sample spacing (range / samples)
slant_range_correction.water_column: slant samples nearer than the altitude map to no ground range and are excluded from the image by construction; they are kept in the water-column file

gain_normalisation.method: empirical gain normalisation: value / mean(value) per ground-range bin, over the line, per side, resolved by altitude bands of EGN_ALTITUDE_BAND_M; the mean surface is Gaussian-smoothed by normalised convolution (EGN_SMOOTH_ALTITUDE_M, EGN_SMOOTH_RANGE_M) and interpolated linearly in altitude per ping; cells with less than EGN_MIN_PINGS effective pings use the line-wide profile; the mean is trimmed in a second pass to pixels whose EGN_TRIM_WINDOW local-mean ratio to the first-pass surface is within EGN_TRIM_LOW..EGN_TRIM_HIGH, so large targets and shadows do not set the gain
gain_normalisation.roll_balance: per-side normalisation removes constant port/starboard imbalance; the part that varies with roll is removed by dividing each ping-side by its median normalised intensity (within the EGN trim band), median-smoothed over ROLL_BALANCE_PINGS

along_track.method: rows at fixed distance travelled; each row linearly interpolated between the two usable pings that bracket it

rules.interpolated: rows inside a degraded gap (time gap, empty or unusable pings) of at most INTERP_MAX_ROWS rows
rules.dropout: rows inside a gap longer than INTERP_MAX_ROWS; left as zero pixels, attitude/altitude/depth null
rules.attitude: nearest ping exceeds MAX_PITCH_DEG, MAX_ROLL_DEG or MAX_HEAVE_RATE (held for ATTITUDE_HOLD_S); data kept
rules.nav_jump: nearest ping's navigation fix implied a speed above MAX_SPEED_MPS and was rejected; lat/lon null on the row

dropouts.positions_in_dropouts: lat/lon/time on interpolated and dropout rows are interpolated between the real fixes either side

speckle.noise: estimated inside lee_filter from var/mean^2 of the image
speckle.applied: after gain normalisation and along-track resampling, before 8-bit scaling

intensity_scaling.encoding: valid pixels scaled to 1..255; 0 means no data

geometry_not_corrected: layback: the recorded sensor position is used as the towfish position
pitch and yaw displacement of the beam footprint
layover: tall objects appear slightly nearer nadir than they are
seabed slope across the swath: slant-range correction assumes a flat seabed
processing.synthetic_basis: XTF NoteString or notes packet contains 'SYNTHETIC'

arrays.bottom_range_m: rows float32, slant range of the first bottom return used for the row, NaN if unknown

water_column.note: slant-range bins from the transducer to the first bottom return; intensity after gain normalisation; not speckle-filtered
water_column.normalisation: same per-ping, per-side roll balance as the image, then each slant bin divided by its median over the line (median, not mean, so fish schools do not raise their own reference)
water_column.bin_order: bin 0 at the transducer on both channels (port is NOT mirrored)
water_column.row_alignment: row i is row i of the PNG and of the sidecar rows; dropout rows and bins beyond the row's bottom range are NaN
